newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Euro seen lifting European share prices, volumes.
newsitem.headline: Euro seen lifting European share prices, volumes.

text.p: The introduction of the single European currency should increase prices and trading volumes on European stock exchanges, European stock exchange officials said on Friday.
Jean-Francois Theodore, chairman of the Paris stock exchange, said history showed that markets rose as a result of events that "brought down barriers" and "gave (markets) new dimensions".
"We have seen that in other businesses since the Treaty of Rome (which set up the European Economic Community)," he told a news conference.
"It's a reasonably good assumption that it will be the same in the securities business," he added.
Antonio Zoido, who heads the Federation of European Stock Exchanges and the Madrid stock exchange, said trading volumes on the major European exchanges would increase with the advent of the euro.
"To begin with, that is going to reduce transaction costs, if only because it will bring more volume and liquidity to the market," he told reporters.
The news conference was held after the two-day annual meeting of the 17-exchange federation.
